## Epic-Norfolk analysis code: Physical Behaviour and Dementia

### Baseline analysis

Descriptive statistics for HC3 participants

```{r description of HC3 participants}
#What are the total person-years?
sum(FinalHC3$HC3_FOLLOW_UP)

#What is the follow-up distribution
favstats(~ HC3_FOLLOW_UP, data = FinalHC3)
boxplot(FinalHC3$HC3_FOLLOW_UP)

# How many participants have > 10 years of follow-up
sum(FinalHC3$HC3_FOLLOW_UP >= 10)
1807/2320*100 # 78%

# What is the age distribution?
favstats(~ DOC_AGE_HC3, data = FinalHC3)
describe(FinalHC3$DOC_HC3)

# How many people had accelerometer measures for seven days?
xtabs(~ VALID_DAYS_BOUTS_HC3, FinalHC3)

# What are the total incident dementia cases?
FinalHC3 |> filter(if_any(c(INC_DEMENTIA_AD, INC_DEMENTIA_VASCULAR, INC_DEMENTIA_OTH,INC_DEMENTIA_ALL), ~ .x==1)) |> 
  summarise (Unique_Dementia_Cases = n_distinct(RELEASEID))
xtabs(~ INC_DEMENTIA_VASCULAR + INC_DEMENTIA_AD + INC_DEMENTIA_OTH, FinalHC3)
```

Physical behaviour descriptions

```{r distribution of PB variables}
# Total Physical Activity (TPA)
hist(FinalHC3$TPA) # Positive skew
favstats(FinalHC3$TPA)

# Moderate-to-vigorous Physical Activity (MVPA)
hist(FinalHC3$MVPA) # Positive skew
favstats(FinalHC3$MVPA)

# Light Physical Activity (LPA)
hist(FinalHC3$LPA) # Normally distributed
favstats(FinalHC3$LPA)

# Sedentary time
hist(FinalHC3$ST) # Normally distributed
favstats(FinalHC3$ST)

# Sedentary bout time
hist(FinalHC3$SEDBOUT)
favstats(FinalHC3$SEDBOUT)

# Number of people achieving more than 150 mins MVPA a week? (extrapolating)
FinalHC3 <- FinalHC3 |> mutate(weeklyMVPA = MVPA*7)
favstats(FinalHC3$weeklyMVPA)

FinalHC3recomm <- FinalHC3 |> filter(weeklyMVPA >= 150)
dim(FinalHC3recomm)
```

HC3 datasets by sex
```{r datasets by sex}
FinalHC3_F <- FinalHC3[FinalHC3$FEMALE == 1,]
dim(FinalHC3_F)
xtabs(~ INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM, FinalHC3_F)

FinalHC3_M <- FinalHC3[FinalHC3$FEMALE== 0,]
dim(FinalHC3_M)
xtabs(~ INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM, FinalHC3_M)
```

Table of baseline physical behaviour (n = 2320)
```{r Baseline (HC3) PB table}
# Exposure variables of interest
HC3Exp <- c("TPA",
            "MVPA",
            "LPA",
            "ST",
            "SEDBOUT")

HC3Explabels <- list(TPA = "TPA (cpm)",
                     MVPA = "MVPA (min/day)",
                     LPA = "LPA (min/day)",
                     ST = "Total sedentary time (min/day)",
                     SEDBOUT = "Prolonged sedentary time (min/day)")

hc3_PB.tbl <- FinalHC3 |>
  tbl_summary(
    include = HC3Exp,
    by = INC_DEMENTIA_ALL,
    missing = "ifany",
    statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{mean}, ({sd})"),
    label = HC3Explabels
  ) |> add_p() |> bold_p(t = 0.05) |>
  modify_caption("**Table. Baseline Participant Physical behaviour by Dementia Outcome**")
print(hc3_PB.tbl)
```

## Survival analysis

### Whole cohort

Creating survivor function
```{r, include = FALSE}
# Survival in the overall cohort
dim(FinalHC3)
str(FinalHC3)

# Survivor function = time, event

FinalHC3_Surv <- Surv(FinalHC3$HC3_FOLLOW_UP, FinalHC3$INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM)
FinalHC3_Surv

FinalHC3DEM <- FinalHC3 |> filter(INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM == 1)
colnames(FinalHC3DEM)
describe(FinalHC3DEM$EOF_Y10TH)

FinalHC3DEM <- FinalHC3DEM |> mutate(AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS = DOC_AGE_HC3 + HC3_FOLLOW_UP)
favstats(FinalHC3DEM$AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS)

# KM PLOT FOR WHOLE COHORT

KM_Overall <- survfit(FinalHC3_Surv ~ 1, data = FinalHC3)
plot(KM_Overall, xlab = 'Years',
     ylab = 'Probability of survival (%)',
     main = 'Kaplan-Meier survivor function',
     mark.time=T, # tick marks at times when individuals are censored
     yscale =100) # survival expressed as percentrage rather than probability
summary(KM_Overall, times=c(1:20)) # probability of surviving up to year 17 is 83% (80.8 - 85.5% CI)
```

Unadjusted; Minimally adjusted; Fully adjusted Cox Models
```{r Whole cohort survival analysis}

# ==============================================================================
#               COX PH: PHYSICAL BEHAVIOUR FOR ALL PARTICIPANTS
# ==============================================================================

# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 1: UNADJUSTED
# ==============================================================================

# ===================
# TPA (cpm)
# ===================
Cox_TPA <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ TPA, data = FinalHC3)
Cox_TPA.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_TPA, exponentiate = TRUE,
                              label = list(TPA = "TPA (cpm)"))
summary(Cox_TPA)
TPAzph <- cox.zph(Cox_TPA)
TPAzph
plot(TPAzph)

# ===================
# MVPA 10min/daily
# ===================
Cox_MVPA10 <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ MVPA_10min, data = FinalHC3)
Cox_MVPA10.tbl  <- tbl_regression(Cox_MVPA10, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                  label = list(MVPA_10min = "MVPA (10 min/d)"))
MVPAzph <- cox.zph(Cox_MVPA10)
MVPAzph
plot(MVPAzph)

# ===================
# LPA 10min/daily
# ===================
Cox_LPA10 <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ LPA_10min, data = FinalHC3)
Cox_LPA10.tbl  <- tbl_regression(Cox_LPA10, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                 label = list(LPA_10min = "LPA (10 min/d)"))
LPAzph <- cox.zph(Cox_LPA10)
LPAzph
plot(LPAzph)

# ===================
# Sed time 10min/daily
# ===================
Cox_ST10 <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ ST_10min, data = FinalHC3)
Cox_ST10.tbl  <- tbl_regression(Cox_ST10, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                label = list(ST_10min = "Sedentary time (10 min/d)"))
STzph <- cox.zph(Cox_ST10)
STzph
plot(STzph)

# ===================
# Bouts of sedentary time over 30 mins
# ===================
Cox_SB <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ SEDBOUT, FinalHC3)
Cox_SB.tbl  <- tbl_regression(Cox_SB, exponentiate = TRUE,
                              label = list(SEDBOUT = "Sedentary bout time (min)"))
summary(Cox_SB)
SBzph <- cox.zph(Cox_SB)
plot(SBzph)

# Merged coxph table for MODEL 0: UNADJUSTED
All_unadj <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(Cox_TPA.tbl,  Cox_MVPA10.tbl,  Cox_LPA10.tbl, Cox_ST10.tbl,  Cox_SB.tbl))|> 
  bold_p(t = 0.05) |>  modify_header(label = "**Physical Behaviour (Increment)**")
All_unadj

# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 2: AGE and SEX ADJUSTED 
# ==============================================================================

# TPA (cpm)
Cox_TPA.1 <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ TPA + DOC_AGE_HC3 + FEMALE, data = FinalHC3)
Cox_TPA.1.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_TPA.1, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "TPA",
                                label = list(TPA = "TPA (cpm)"))

# MVPA (10min/daily)
Cox_MVPA10.1 <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ MVPA_10min + DOC_AGE_HC3 + FEMALE, data = FinalHC3)
Cox_MVPA10.1.tbl  <- tbl_regression(Cox_MVPA10.1, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "MVPA_10min",
                                    label = list(MVPA_10min = "MVPA (10 min/d)"))

# LPA (10min/daily)
Cox_LPA10.1 <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ LPA_10min + DOC_AGE_HC3 + FEMALE, data = FinalHC3)
Cox_LPA10.1.tbl  <- tbl_regression(Cox_LPA10.1, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "LPA_10min",
                                   label = list(LPA_10min = "LPA (10 min/d)"))

# Sedentary time (10min/daily)
Cox_ST10.1 <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ ST_10min + DOC_AGE_HC3 + FEMALE, data = FinalHC3)
Cox_ST10.1.tbl  <- tbl_regression(Cox_ST10.1, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "ST_10min",
                                  label = list(ST_10min = "Sedentary time (10 min/d)"))

# Sed bout time (min)
Cox_SB.1 <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ SEDBOUT + DOC_AGE_HC3 + FEMALE, FinalHC3)
Cox_SB.1.tbl  <- tbl_regression(Cox_SB.1, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "SEDBOUT",
                                label = list(SEDBOUT = "Sedentary bout time (min)"))
summary(Cox_SB.1)

# Merged tables for MODEL 1: AGE and SEX ADJUSTED
All_age_sex.adj <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(Cox_TPA.1.tbl , Cox_MVPA10.1.tbl, Cox_LPA10.1.tbl, Cox_ST10.1.tbl, Cox_SB.1.tbl)
) |>   bold_p(t = 0.05) 
All_age_sex.adj

# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 3: ALL COVARIATE ADJUSTED 
# ==============================================================================
covariates_list <- ~ FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC3 + EDLEVEL09 + RETIRED3 + 
                     URBANRURALSTATUS + CIGSTAT3 + UNITNOW3 + 
                     MARITAL_STATUS3 + ALT_BMI_HC3 + BP2 + 
                     HEARING_FU4 + PREV_DISEASE

# TPA Model and Table
Cox_TPA.cov <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ TPA + 
                       covariates_list, data = FinalHC3)
Cox_TPA.cov.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_TPA.cov, exponentiate = TRUE, 
                                  include = "TPA",
                                  label = list(TPA = "TPA (cpm)"))

# MVPA 10min/d Model and Table
Cox_MVPA10.cov <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ MVPA_10min + 
                          covariates_list,
                        data = FinalHC3)
table_mvpa10_cov <- tbl_regression(
  Cox_MVPA10.cov, 
  exponentiate = TRUE, include = "MVPA_10min", label = list(MVPA_10min = "MVPA (10 min/d)")
)

# LPA 10min/d
Cox_LPA10.cov <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ LPA_10min + 
                         covariates_list, data = FinalHC3)
table_lpa10_cov <- tbl_regression(
  Cox_LPA10.cov, 
  exponentiate = TRUE, 
  include = "LPA_10min",
  label = list(LPA_10min = "LPA (10 min/d)")
)

# SED TIME 10min/d
Cox_ST10.cov <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ ST_10min + 
                        covariates_list, data = FinalHC3)
table_st10_cov <- tbl_regression(
  Cox_ST10.cov, 
  exponentiate = TRUE, 
  include = "ST_10min",
  label = list(ST_10min = "Sedentary time (10 min/d)")
)

# SEDBOUT 10min/d
Cox_SB.cov <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ SEDBOUT + 
                      covariates_list, data = FinalHC3)

table_sb_cov <- tbl_regression(
  Cox_SB.cov, 
  exponentiate = TRUE, 
  include = "SEDBOUT",
  label = list(SEDBOUT = "Sedentary bout time (min)")
)

final_exposure_table_cov <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(Cox_TPA.cov.tbl,
              table_mvpa10_cov, 
              table_lpa10_cov, 
              table_st10_cov,
              table_sb_cov)
) |>   bold_p(t = 0.05) 

final_exposure_table_cov
```

Table for whole cohort Cox models 1, 2, 3
```{r Whole cohort table}
All_HC3cox.tbl <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(All_unadj, All_age_sex.adj, final_exposure_table_cov),
  tab_spanner = c("**Unadjusted**", "**Minimally Adjusted**", "**Fully Adjusted**") 
) |> modify_header(label = "Baseline Physical Behaviour") |> as_gt() |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = pct(80))
print(All_HC3cox.tbl)
```

###Sensitivity analysis: Model 3 + adjustment for other physical behaviours
```{r, Model 3 + adjustment for other physical behaviours}
# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 4: ALL COVARIATE ADJUSTED + other physical behaviours
# ==============================================================================

covariates_list <- ~ FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC3 + EDLEVEL09 + RETIRED3 + 
                     URBANRURALSTATUS + CIGSTAT3 + UNITNOW3 + 
                     MARITAL_STATUS3 + ALT_BMI_HC3 + BP2 + 
                     HEARING_FU4 + PREV_DISEASE

# MVPA 10min/d Model and Table
Cox_MVPA10.cov2 <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ MVPA_10min + 
                          LPA_10min + 
                          ST_10min +
                          covariates_list,
                        data = FinalHC3)

table_mvpa10_cov2 <- tbl_regression(
  Cox_MVPA10.cov2, 
  exponentiate = TRUE, include = "MVPA_10min", label = list(MVPA_10min = "MVPA (10 min/d)")
)

# LPA 10min/d
Cox_LPA10.cov2 <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ LPA_10min + 
                         MVPA_10min +
                         ST_10min +
                         covariates_list, data = FinalHC3)
table_lpa10_cov2 <- tbl_regression(
  Cox_LPA10.cov2, 
  exponentiate = TRUE, 
  include = "LPA_10min",
  label = list(LPA_10min = "LPA (10 min/d)")
)

# SED TIME 10min/d
Cox_ST10.cov2 <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ ST_10min + 
                        MVPA_10min +
                        LPA_10min +
                        covariates_list, data = FinalHC3)
table_st10_cov2 <- tbl_regression(
  Cox_ST10.cov2, 
  exponentiate = TRUE, 
  include = "ST_10min",
  label = list(ST_10min = "Sedentary time (10 min/d)")
)


# SEDBOUT 10min/d
Cox_SB.cov2 <- coxph(FinalHC3_Surv ~ SEDBOUT + 
                      MVPA_10min +
                      LPA_10min +
                      ST_10min +
                      covariates_list, data = FinalHC3)

table_sb_cov2 <- tbl_regression(
  Cox_SB.cov2, 
  exponentiate = TRUE, 
  include = "SEDBOUT",
  label = list(SEDBOUT = "Sedentary bout time (min)")
)

final_exposure_table_cov2 <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(table_mvpa10_cov2, 
              table_lpa10_cov2, 
              table_st10_cov2,
              table_sb_cov2)
) |>   bold_p(t = 0.05) 

final_exposure_table_cov2
```

###Sensitivity analysis: excluding participants with dementia in first 2 years
```{r, Excluding those with dementia in first 2 years}
FinalHC3_nodem2 <- FinalHC3 |> filter(!(INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM == 1 & HC3_FOLLOW_UP <= 2))
dim(FinalHC3_nodem2)

# Survivor function = time, event
FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv <- Surv(FinalHC3_nodem2$HC3_FOLLOW_UP, FinalHC3_nodem2$INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM)
FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv


# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 1: UNADJUSTED
# ==============================================================================

# TPA (cpm)
model1_tpa <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv ~ TPA, data = FinalHC3_nodem2)
table1_tpa <- tbl_regression(model1_tpa, exponentiate = TRUE,
                             label = list(TPA = "TPA (cpm)"))

# MVPA (10 min/daily)
model1_mvpa10 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv ~ MVPA_10min, data = FinalHC3_nodem2)
table1_mvpa10 <- tbl_regression(model1_mvpa10, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                label = list(MVPA_10min = "MVPA (10 min/d)"))

# LPA (10 min/daily)
model1_lpa10 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv ~ LPA_10min, data = FinalHC3_nodem2)
table1_lpa10 <- tbl_regression(model1_lpa10, exponentiate = TRUE,
                               label = list(LPA_10min = "LPA (10 min/d)"))

# Sedentary time (10 min/daily)
model1_st10 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv ~ ST_10min, data = FinalHC3_nodem2)
table1_st10 <- tbl_regression(model1_st10, exponentiate = TRUE,
                              label = list(ST_10min = "Sedentary time (10 min/d)"))

# Sedentary bout time (>30 mins)
model1_sb <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv ~ SEDBOUT, data = FinalHC3_nodem2)
table1_sb <- tbl_regression(model1_sb, exponentiate = TRUE,
                            label = list(SEDBOUT = "Sedentary bout time (min)"))

# Merged table for MODEL 1: UNADJUSTED
table_unadjusted_merged <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(table1_tpa, table1_mvpa10, table1_lpa10, table1_st10, table1_sb)
) |>  
  bold_p(t = 0.05) |>  
  modify_header(label = "**Physical Behaviour (Increment)**")
table_unadjusted_merged


# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 2: AGE AND SEX ADJUSTED 
# ==============================================================================

model2_tpa <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv ~ TPA + DOC_AGE_HC3 + FEMALE, data = FinalHC3_nodem2)
table2_tpa <- tbl_regression(model2_tpa, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "TPA",
                             label = list(TPA = "TPA (cpm)"))

model2_mvpa10 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv ~ MVPA_10min + DOC_AGE_HC3 + FEMALE, data = FinalHC3_nodem2)
table2_mvpa10 <- tbl_regression(model2_mvpa10, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "MVPA_10min",
                                label = list(MVPA_10min = "MVPA (10 min/d)"))

model2_lpa10 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv ~ LPA_10min + DOC_AGE_HC3 + FEMALE, data = FinalHC3_nodem2)
table2_lpa10 <- tbl_regression(model2_lpa10, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "LPA_10min",
                               label = list(LPA_10min = "LPA (10 min/d)"))

model2_st10 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv ~ ST_10min + DOC_AGE_HC3 + FEMALE, data = FinalHC3_nodem2)
table2_st10 <- tbl_regression(model2_st10, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "ST_10min",
                              label = list(ST_10min = "Sedentary time (10 min/d)"))

model2_sb <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv ~ SEDBOUT + DOC_AGE_HC3 + FEMALE, data = FinalHC3_nodem2)
table2_sb <- tbl_regression(model2_sb, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "SEDBOUT",
                            label = list(SEDBOUT = "Sedentary bout time (min)"))
summary(model2_sb)

# Merged table for MODEL 2: AGE and SEX ADJUSTED
table_agesex_adjusted_merged <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(table2_tpa, table2_mvpa10, table2_lpa10, table2_st10, table2_sb)
) |>  
  bold_p(t = 0.05) 
table_agesex_adjusted_merged


# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 3: FULLY COVARIATE ADJUSTED 
# ==============================================================================

covariates_list <- ~ FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC3 + EDLEVEL09 + RETIRED3 + 
                     URBANRURALSTATUS + CIGSTAT3 + UNITNOW3 + 
                     MARITAL_STATUS3 + ALT_BMI_HC3 + BP2 + 
                     HEARING_FU4 + PREV_DISEASE

model3_tpa <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv ~ TPA, covariates_list), data = FinalHC3_nodem2)
table3_tpa <- tbl_regression(model3_tpa, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "TPA",
                             label = list(TPA = "TPA (cpm)"))

model3_mvpa10 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv ~ MVPA_10min, covariates_list), data = FinalHC3_nodem2)
table3_mvpa10 <- tbl_regression(model3_mvpa10, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "MVPA_10min",
                                label = list(MVPA_10min = "MVPA (10 min/d)"))

model3_lpa10 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv ~ LPA_10min, covariates_list), data = FinalHC3_nodem2)
table3_lpa10 <- tbl_regression(model3_lpa10, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "LPA_10min",
                               label = list(LPA_10min = "LPA (10 min/d)"))

model3_st10 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv ~ ST_10min, covariates_list), data = FinalHC3_nodem2)
table3_st10 <- tbl_regression(model3_st10, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "ST_10min",
                              label = list(ST_10min = "Sedentary time (10 min/d)"))

model3_sb <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC3_nodem2_Surv ~ SEDBOUT, covariates_list), data = FinalHC3_nodem2)
table3_sb <- tbl_regression(model3_sb, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "SEDBOUT",
                            label = list(SEDBOUT = "Sedentary bout time (min)"))
summary(model3_sb)

# Merged table for MODEL 3: FULLY ADJUSTED
table_fully_adjusted_merged <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(table3_tpa, table3_mvpa10, table3_lpa10, table3_st10, table3_sb)
) |>  
  bold_p(t = 0.05) 
table_fully_adjusted_merged


# ==============================================================================
# COMBINED SUMMARY TABLE (MODELS 1, 2, 3)
# ==============================================================================
final_combined_cox_table <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(table_unadjusted_merged, table_agesex_adjusted_merged, table_fully_adjusted_merged),
  tab_spanner = c("**Unadjusted**", "**Minimally Adjusted**", "**Fully Adjusted**") 
) |> 
  modify_header(label = "Baseline Physical Behaviour (Excl. pts with dementia before two-year follow-up") |> 
  as_gt() |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = pct(80))

print(final_combined_cox_table)
```

###Sensitivity analysis: excluding participants with dementia in first 5 years
```{r, Excluding those with dementia in first 5 years}
FinalHC3_nodem5 <- FinalHC3 |> filter(!(INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM == 1 & HC3_FOLLOW_UP <= 5))
dim(FinalHC3_nodem5)

# Survivor function = time, event
FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv <- Surv(FinalHC3_nodem5$HC3_FOLLOW_UP, FinalHC3_nodem5$INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM)
FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv
# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 1: UNADJUSTED (5-Year Exclusion)
# ==============================================================================

# TPA (cpm)
model1_tpa_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv ~ TPA, data = FinalHC3_nodem5)
table1_tpa_nodem5 <- tbl_regression(model1_tpa_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                    label = list(TPA = "TPA (cpm)"))

# MVPA (10 min/daily)
model1_mvpa10_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv ~ MVPA_10min, data = FinalHC3_nodem5)
table1_mvpa10_nodem5 <- tbl_regression(model1_mvpa10_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                       label = list(MVPA_10min = "MVPA (10 min/d)"))

# LPA (10 min/daily)
model1_lpa10_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv ~ LPA_10min, data = FinalHC3_nodem5)
table1_lpa10_nodem5 <- tbl_regression(model1_lpa10_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                      label = list(LPA_10min = "LPA (10 min/d)"))

# Sedentary time (10 min/daily)
model1_st10_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv ~ ST_10min, data = FinalHC3_nodem5)
table1_st10_nodem5 <- tbl_regression(model1_st10_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                     label = list(ST_10min = "Sedentary time (10 min/d)"))

# Sedentary bout time (>30 mins)
model1_sb_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv ~ SEDBOUT, data = FinalHC3_nodem5)
table1_sb_nodem5 <- tbl_regression(model1_sb_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                   label = list(SEDBOUT = "Sedentary bout time (min)"))

# Merged table for MODEL 1: UNADJUSTED
table_unadjusted_merged_nodem5 <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(table1_tpa_nodem5, table1_mvpa10_nodem5, table1_lpa10_nodem5, table1_st10_nodem5, table1_sb_nodem5)
) |>  
  bold_p(t = 0.05) |>  
  modify_header(label = "**Physical Behaviour (Increment)**")
table_unadjusted_merged_nodem5


# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 2: AGE AND SEX ADJUSTED (5-Year Exclusion)
# ==============================================================================

model2_tpa_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv ~ TPA + DOC_AGE_HC3 + FEMALE, data = FinalHC3_nodem5)
table2_tpa_nodem5 <- tbl_regression(model2_tpa_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "TPA",
                                    label = list(TPA = "TPA (cpm)"))

model2_mvpa10_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv ~ MVPA_10min + DOC_AGE_HC3 + FEMALE, data = FinalHC3_nodem5)
table2_mvpa10_nodem5 <- tbl_regression(model2_mvpa10_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "MVPA_10min",
                                       label = list(MVPA_10min = "MVPA (10 min/d)"))

model2_lpa10_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv ~ LPA_10min + DOC_AGE_HC3 + FEMALE, data = FinalHC3_nodem5)
table2_lpa10_nodem5 <- tbl_regression(model2_lpa10_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "LPA_10min",
                                      label = list(LPA_10min = "LPA (10 min/d)"))

model2_st10_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv ~ ST_10min + DOC_AGE_HC3 + FEMALE, data = FinalHC3_nodem5)
table2_st10_nodem5 <- tbl_regression(model2_st10_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "ST_10min",
                                     label = list(ST_10min = "Sedentary time (10 min/d)"))

model2_sb_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv ~ SEDBOUT + DOC_AGE_HC3 + FEMALE, data = FinalHC3_nodem5)
table2_sb_nodem5 <- tbl_regression(model2_sb_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "SEDBOUT",
                                   label = list(SEDBOUT = "Sedentary bout time (min)"))
summary(model2_sb_nodem5)

# Merged table for MODEL 2: AGE and SEX ADJUSTED
table_agesex_adjusted_merged_nodem5 <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(table2_tpa_nodem5, table2_mvpa10_nodem5, table2_lpa10_nodem5, table2_st10_nodem5, table2_sb_nodem5)
) |>  
  bold_p(t = 0.05) 
table_agesex_adjusted_merged_nodem5


# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 3: FULLY COVARIATE ADJUSTED (5-Year Exclusion)
# ==============================================================================

covariates_list <- ~ FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC3 + EDLEVEL09 + RETIRED3 + 
                     URBANRURALSTATUS + CIGSTAT3 + UNITNOW3 + 
                     MARITAL_STATUS3 + ALT_BMI_HC3 + BP2 + 
                     HEARING_FU4 + PREV_DISEASE

model3_tpa_nodem5 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv ~ TPA, covariates_list), data = FinalHC3_nodem5)
table3_tpa_nodem5 <- tbl_regression(model3_tpa_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "TPA",
                                    label = list(TPA = "TPA (cpm)"))

model3_mvpa10_nodem5 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv ~ MVPA_10min, covariates_list), data = FinalHC3_nodem5)
table3_mvpa10_nodem5 <- tbl_regression(model3_mvpa10_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "MVPA_10min",
                                       label = list(MVPA_10min = "MVPA (10 min/d)"))

model3_lpa10_nodem5 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv ~ LPA_10min, covariates_list), data = FinalHC3_nodem5)
table3_lpa10_nodem5 <- tbl_regression(model3_lpa10_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "LPA_10min",
                                      label = list(LPA_10min = "LPA (10 min/d)"))

model3_st10_nodem5 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv ~ ST_10min, covariates_list), data = FinalHC3_nodem5)
table3_st10_nodem5 <- tbl_regression(model3_st10_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "ST_10min",
                                     label = list(ST_10min = "Sedentary time (10 min/d)"))

model3_sb_nodem5 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC3_nodem5_Surv ~ SEDBOUT, covariates_list), data = FinalHC3_nodem5)
table3_sb_nodem5 <- tbl_regression(model3_sb_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "SEDBOUT",
                                   label = list(SEDBOUT = "Sedentary bout time (min)"))
summary(model3_sb_nodem5)

# Merged table for MODEL 3: FULLY ADJUSTED
table_fully_adjusted_merged_nodem5 <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(table3_tpa_nodem5, table3_mvpa10_nodem5, table3_lpa10_nodem5, table3_st10_nodem5, table3_sb_nodem5)
) |>  
  bold_p(t = 0.05) 
table_fully_adjusted_merged_nodem5


# ==============================================================================
# COMBINED SUMMARY TABLE (MODELS 1, 2, 3 - 5-Year Exclusion)
# ==============================================================================
final_combined_cox_table_nodem5 <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(table_unadjusted_merged_nodem5, table_agesex_adjusted_merged_nodem5, table_fully_adjusted_merged_nodem5),
  tab_spanner = c("**Unadjusted**", "**Minimally Adjusted**", "**Fully Adjusted**") 
) |>  
  modify_header(label = "Baseline Physical Behaviour (Excl. pts with dementia before five-year follow-up)") |>  
  as_gt() |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = pct(80))

print(final_combined_cox_table_nodem5)
```
